purpose.zh: 练腹部，提升悬撑时的卷腹抬腿能力
purpose.en: Build the abs and control the knee raise in a dip-bar support.

text.zh: 手臂锁直撑起，骨盆后倾卷腹抬腿
text.en: Lock your arms, tilt your pelvis back, and curl your knees up

text.zh: 膝盖抬到大腿高于水平，停一下
text.en: Raise your knees until your thighs pass level, and pause.
Lower slowly without swinging your legs.

commonErrors.en: Letting the shoulders sink toward the ears.

cautions.zh: 肩前侧夹痛时缩小幅度或换简单版本
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, reduce the range or switch to an easier version.
